items.markdown:
Perth’s top luxury real estate options are anchored by specialized boutique firms and high-performing prestige networks dominating the affluent western suburbs and riverside enclaves. The standout agencies for high-net-worth transactions include [William Porteous Properties International](https://porteous.com.au/), Ray White Dalkeith | Claremont (led by elite performers like Vivien Yap), and Inhabit Property.
